_notes: Example LLM profiles for data/user/settings/model_catalog.json. Keys are environment references only: "${NAME}" is read from the backend's environment when a profile is used, is never written back to disk, and is masked as *** by the settings API. The desktop shell supplies OPENCODE_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

PRIVACY: the OpenCode Go Muse Spark 1.3 contributor tier (muse-spark-1.3-contributor) grants Meta permission to train future models on your prompts and completions. It is not zero-retention. Do not send corpus text to it; the active profile here is the Zen standard tier.

OpenCode Zen states that its other models follow a zero-retention, no-training policy, and that requests to Anthropic models are retained for 30 days under Anthropic's data policies. Check both before sending corpus text.
Muse Spark has mandatory reasoning: a reasoning_effort of none is sent as minimal. The standard tier (muse-spark-1.3 on Zen) also accepts max; the contributor tier does not.

Claude Opus 5.5 runs at effort medium when none is set, so effort is explicit here. Thinking cannot be turned off on Opus 5.5 (none is sent as effort low); on Sonnet 5.5, none is sent as thinking between_tools.
OpenCode Zen's model list did not include claude-sonnet-5-5 on 2026-09-30; its profile may fail until Zen adds it.
The settings UI offers only none/adaptive for these Claude models and does not offer xhigh for OpenCode, so set reasoning_effort in this file.

profiles.name: OpenCode Go - Muse Spark (contributor tier, trains on prompts)
